name: scp-foundation
questions: Tell me about the SCP Foundation
What does the SCP Foundation do?
What is the SCP Foundation about?
answer: The SCP Foundation is a fictional secret organization that finds, contains and protects the world from anomalous objects, creatures and places. It's also a huge online collaborative writing project, with thousands of fan-written entries.

name: scp-origin
questions: When did the SCP Foundation start?
When was the SCP Foundation created?
How did the SCP Foundation start?
What is the history of SCP?
answer: SCP began in 2007 with SCP-173, a short post on a paranormal message board. It has since grown into a massive collaborative writing project, with thousands of entries written by fans.

name: object-classes
questions: What are the SCP object classes?
What are the SCP containment classes?
What do Safe Euclid and Keter mean?
answer: Object classes describe how hard an SCP is to contain. Safe means it can be contained reliably (not necessarily harmless!), Euclid means it's unpredictable or not fully understood, and Keter means it's very difficult to contain reliably. There are a few rarer classes too.

name: d-class
answer: In the SCP universe, D-Class are expendable personnel, usually drawn from prisoners, who are sent to do the dangerous jobs, like testing and interacting with SCPs.

name: mtf
questions: What is a Mobile Task Force?
answer: MTF stands for Mobile Task Force. In the SCP universe, they're specialist Foundation teams sent out on specific missions, like Nine-Tailed Fox.

name: o5-council-lore
questions: Who is in charge of the Foundation?
answer: In the lore, the O5 Council is the secretive group of thirteen people who run the Foundation. In SCP: NM, they're part of campaign mode and oversee your facility.

name: sites
questions: What is a site in SCP?
answer: In the SCP lore, Sites are Foundation facilities that house and study anomalies, and Site-19 is one of the best known. In SCP: NM, you build and run your own!

name: containment-breach
answer: A containment breach is when an SCP escapes from its containment and starts causing trouble. It's usually very bad news.

name: anomaly
answer: In SCP, an anomaly is anything that breaks the normal rules of reality, like objects, creatures, places or even ideas.

name: is-scp-real
answer: Nope, it's all fiction! SCP is a collaborative horror and sci-fi writing project.

name: scp-173-lore
answer: SCP-173, 'The Sculpture', is a statue that can't move while anyone is looking at it, but moves extremely fast the moment no one is. It was the very first SCP ever written.

name: scp-096-lore
answer: SCP-096, 'The Shy Guy', is a tall humanoid that flies into a rage and hunts down anyone who sees its face.

name: scp-049-lore
answer: SCP-049, 'The Plague Doctor', believes it's curing a deadly 'pestilence', and its touch is fatal.

name: scp-106-lore
answer: SCP-106, 'The Old Man', corrodes what it touches and drags people into its own pocket dimension.

name: scp-079-lore
answer: SCP-079 is an old computer with a mind of its own. It's smart, it's bored, and it really wants out.

name: scp-999-lore
answer: SCP-999, 'The Tickle Monster', is a friendly orange blob that makes people happy. It's one of the most beloved SCPs.

name: scp-682-lore
questions: What is the Hard to Destroy Reptile?
answer: SCP-682, 'The Hard-to-Destroy Reptile', is a hugely adaptable, regenerating creature that hates all life. Nothing has managed to destroy it yet.

name: scp-035-lore
answer: SCP-035 is a mask that influences people into wearing it, and then takes control of them.

name: scp-3008-lore
answer: SCP-3008 is an ordinary-looking IKEA store that is infinitely big on the inside, and its 'employees' get hostile at night.

name: scp-087-lore
answer: SCP-087 is an endless, dark staircase. Something unsettling seems to live down there.
